rules.accepted_credit_types: General hours approved by a state or national organization empowered to accredit nursing CE; mandatory subjects board-approved (human trafficking per s. 464.013); controlled-substance course from a statewide physicians association accredited for AMA PRA Category 1, ANCC, AANA or AANP; live or home study
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses not issued for the full biennium need 1 hour of CE per month held.
rules.alternatives: Certification by a specialty program accredited by NCCA or ABSNC exempts from CE, but not from the 3-hour controlled-substance course or the 2-hour human trafficking course; report it in CE Broker. Licensees who had to be nationally certified at original licensure must submit current national certification.
rules.notes: Table: 16 general + 2 medical errors + 2 laws and rules + 2 impairment (every other renewal) + 2 human trafficking + 3 safe prescribing of controlled substances (every biennium); domestic violence is extra to the 24 hours. APRNs renew in three groups (Apr 30 2027/2028, Jul 31 2028).
